TYPE-1 NARRATIVE AND PLANS

FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING CHANGE
at 1625 N Keeler Ave, Chicago, Illinois, 60639

The applicant seeks a zoning change from RS-3 (Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District) to RT-4 (Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District) to allow
deconversion of the existing four-unit residential building into a code-compliant three-unit
residential building, including one basement dwelling unit. This application is submitted as a
‘Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment pursuant to §17-13-0300 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance.

The applicant and property owner, J&I Holdings, LLC (Josete Hidvegi and Imre Hidvegi),
is seeking approval of a Type-1 Map Amendment from RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) District to RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District for the
property commonly known as 1625 North Keeler Avenue, Chicago, Illinois 60639.

Subject property is a zoning lot with an area of 3,125 square feet improved with an existing
residential building that currently contains four dwelling units.

The applicant proposes to deconvert the existing building so that the second floor will be
converted from two dwelling units to one, the first floor will be converted from two dwelling units
to one, and a third dwelling unit will be located in the basement, for a total of three dwelling units
in the building.

The applicant explored whether a rezoning to R-3.5 would be feasible, but the site area is
3,125 square feet and does not qualify under the 90% rule for that district. Therefore, the
applicant is requesting the RT-4 classification in order to allow the proposed three-unit
residential building at this location.
